load_struct_model: load a WrapStructModel with ESM-2 base and PDB loader parameters using the load function
load_distogram_model: download and load the linear projection distogram model with ESM-2 650M pretrained weights
run_struct_forward: run a 1-hot sequence tensor through WrapStructModel forward to get distogram and torsion angle logits
process_model_output: process model output dictionary to permute logits and compute softmax probabilities for dist and angles
review_WrapStruct: review the abstract WrapStruct base class that wraps structure models used by the protein Designer
